name: later-gator
description: Single-tenant Raindrop organization and retrieval Worker

scripts.check: npm run types:check && npm run lint && npm run test

STATE.description: Stores small, versioned lifecycle and operational documents. It never stores bookmark content.

AI.description: Runs organization inference when Cloudflare Workers AI is selected.

ORGANIZE_QUEUE.description: Carries bookmark IDs only and invokes one sequential organization job at a time.

EMAIL.description: Sends intervention-required alerts after the owner configures a Cloudflare Email Sending domain and verifies the chosen destination.

MCP_PATH_SECRET.description: A unique, cryptographically random 64-character bootstrap secret for the private MCP endpoint.

INSTALLATION_SECRET.description: A strong, unique password for the private setup page and the root material used to encrypt credentials entered there.
